verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud's product page claims users can understand production systems using natural language and names a first-party Grafana Assistant among its AI capabilities. That shows a natural-language interface exists, but the evidence only covers understanding and investigating, not issuing commands that operate the product. The MCP server is a separate agent-integration story and is not credited here. missing for 10: documentation of what natural-language commands can do (e.g. creating dashboards or alerts, running queries), any availability beyond Cloud marketing claims, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Understand production systems faster using natural language
